prompt: The query in the editor has one mistake. Fix it so that it answers this question: which promotions were never carried by an order line of a product in category 35, Cables? An order line carries a promotion when its promo_id is that promotion's promo_id; most lines carry no promotion, and their promo_id is missing. Return two columns, in this order: promo_id and promo_code. Return one row for each such promotion. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, check what the list after NOT IN holds: most Cables lines have a missing promo_id.
One missing value in that list makes NOT IN keep no promotion at all; test for a matching line instead, or keep the missing values out of the list.
starter_sql:
SELECT promo_id, promo_code
FROM promotions
WHERE promo_id NOT IN (
  SELECT ol.promo_id
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 35
)
why_this_works: NOT EXISTS looks for a Cables line that carries each promotion, so the lines with a missing promo_id never match and cannot wipe out every row.
